title: LION Dynamic Evolution Fitness Standard
purpose: Select the highest-value bounded next evolution candidate on the existing LION Evolution Spine, preferring reusable generative capability over one-off output while preserving authority, currentness, collision and reconciliation invariants.

consumes: CandidateDesign or equivalent bounded candidate description

benefit_dimensions.meaning: new reusable functional capability available after closure
useful producer-consumer integration across existing peers without decorative coupling
direct useful outcome for the operator or downstream product
ability to build or adapt artifacts across more than one task family
degree to which intent-context-provider-artifact-verification-readback becomes one closed path
quality of evidence returned into RAG, lineage, memory and future selection
improvement in deterministic recovery, idempotency and unknown-effect handling
reuse of existing owners, contracts, Beans and materializers rather than parallel infrastructure
independent falsifiability, negative controls and exact readback

cost_dimensions.meaning: risk of widened, inherited or ambiguous authority
scope of possible failure or unintended material effect
number and coupling of architecture/source surfaces invalidated
stale, unknown or expensive-to-refresh evidence introduced or retained
runtime, inference, infrastructure and ongoing maintenance cost

dynamic_pressure.semantics: Pressure may only increase the weight of an existing dimension. It never waives a hard gate and must carry evidence_ref.

algorithm: apply source-bound dynamic pressure to canonical integer weights

optimization_target.near_term: close one real SaaS+LOCAL+material artifact loop inside ai_platform
optimization_target.medium_term: make the same mechanism solve at least two different artifact/application families
optimization_target.long_term: evolve ai_platform into a governed application factory that can improve its own production substrate and build external applications without creating parallel authority or scheduler spines
